delivery_checks: Ordered accepted files and alt text, immutable asset hashes and creative approval identity.
Cover promise, complete readable sequence and final continuation fit the chosen destination; production defects return to content-engine.
Do not assume a photo carousel, PDF document and video montage are interchangeable.

Share mechanic: an uplifting AI news carousel carries one quotable, sourced number or fact on its own card that a person will repeat; a level-up advice carousel carries one move someone forwards to a named colleague, complete on its own. A missing mechanic returns to content-engine as a production defect.
Before Krish sees it: a complete share block (social/share.json), no generic share call to action in the copy, and a blind send test whose reader names the declared receiver and job (crew/send-test).
Bind publication approval to the exact account, caption, ordered asset hashes, metadata and proposed time.
After a save, wait and independently reopen; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying.
measurements: Primary measure (Krish, 28 October 2026): sends, meaning native shares, per reach and saves per reach against the format's own channel median; a house hypothesis until MYMU's own dated data confirms it (lesson share-rate-measure).
Dated exposed reach and meaningful engagement, preserving missing values.
Relevant follower/profile movement and source-attributed publication subscriptions where exposed.
24-hour, 72-hour and seven-day readback after actual publication; no financial ROI inference from draft counts.
